description: Election Commission - Mr. N. M. G. N. Bandara was Selected as the Member of the Rambukkana P.S. Mr. W. P. D. Kumarasiri was Elected as the Member of the No. 01 Ralmaduwa of Wanathawilluwa P. S.  Mr. A. M. S. Jayananda was Elected as the Member of the 13 - Abanpola of Ibbbagamuwa P. S.
reasoning: This gazette content deals specifically with filling vacancies in local government bodies (Pradeshiya Sabhas) due to resignation, death, and election to parliament. It involves electoral procedures under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance, including declarations by Returning Officers about newly elected members to fill these vacancies. This falls under electoral processes and related matters, making it Type 7 (Elections).
